page.layout: One printed page of running text, with the running head at the top right and the page number at the top left. No margin notes. Text runs from a continued commentary paragraph, through a centred chapter heading, to the Bible text in Latin. The last line is a hyphenated word that continues onto the next page.

main_text.p: tionis Jerufalem atq; exitij Affyriorum prædictus fuit, & non nisi re peracta veritas deprehensa est, cap.9.10. 16.17.25.28.29.30.31.33. Tradunt Hebræi, factam hanc stragem noctepaschali, qua etiam mersi sunt Aegyptii hostiliter insequentes. Quod si verum est, pulchre ex-primitur typus liberationis humani generis per Chri-stum à tyrannide spiritualis Sennaherib diaboli. Et pulchre hic describitur, quomodo fuga sibi consuluerit, sicut cap.31. prædicebatur: necnon quomodo gladio ce-cidit in terra sua, quemadmodum paulo ante[?] præsen ti capite propheta est vaticinatus. Horrendum punitæ blasphemiæ & tyrannidis exemplum, ubi tam potens monarcha post visam tatam[?] cladem suorum à propriis filiis domi & in templo interficitur, qui & ipsi pœnas luunt patrati sceleris, dum triste subeunt exilium.
main_text.head: CAPUT XXXVIII.
main_text.p: IN diebus illis ægrotauit Hizkijahu usq; ad mortem: & venit ad eum Jefaiahu filius Amoz propheta, & dixit ad eum: Sic dicit Dominus: Commeda(alicui)domum tuam, quoniam tu morieris & non vives.

Et convertit Hizkijahu faciem suam ad pa-rietem, & oravit ad Dominum, dixitq;: Ob fecro Domine, recordare nunc quòd am-bulaverim coram te in veritate & in corde perfecto, & fecerim quod rectum est in o-culis tuis. fleuit q; Hizkijahu fletu magno. Et fa-

page.notes: The chapter heading is printed as CAPVT XXXVIII.; the V is a vowel here and is given as U. "paulo ante" is printed with a mark over the word that I could not read with certainty. "tatam" is printed with a tilde over the a and may be intended as another word; both are marked [?]. The word "noctepaschali" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. "fecro" is printed for "Obsecro" and is kept as printed. The page has no catchword or signature. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf is not transcribed.
